floor_history.headline: recon: floor=2 is pure sched1 lbu-emission-order swap in FALSE-color branch; regs+opcodes identical, only [b,r,g] vs [r,g,b]; statement-reorder KILLED
s2 structural: struct-cast, walking-pointer, ternary-hoist, block-local-split all KILLED at floor=2; two-block lbu structure is load-bearing (cannot consolidate)

s3 structural: named-intermediate rg, block-local cp, and function-scope cp all KILLED at floor=2 (function-scope cp regressed to 15); CSE/copy-prop collapse leaves sched1 dependence DAG untouched, ch
s4 permuter chassis-1 basin exhausted (~32k iters, ~24 min): best novel score=10 (loop1 boolean staged through existing `b` — dead-store cheat); every sub-40 basin form is variable-reuse / dead-store

s5 permuter: 4 new hoist axes KILLED (r/g/b above if, b above/between loops all regress via callee-save spill across call); chassis-1 fresh-seed run (~15 min, 19k iters) reproduced s4 basin — score-10

frontier.hypothesis: Frontier #2 (remaining) — instrumented cc1 dump (BB2_ALLOC_DEBUG + BB2_SCHED_DEBUG per register-alloc-pure-c) to identify WHICH pseudo/hard-reg differs at FALSE-arm entry (.L80041798) between the s4 baseline and the score-10 cheat form. The pseudo-diff names the exact register-pressure lever a legitimate C form must reproduce WITHOUT extending liveness across the call.
frontier.mechanism: cc1's `;; Register dispositions:` in .greg lists per-pseudo hard-reg assignments + conflict lists. The score-10 form's byte-diff dropped from 2 to ~1 partial because one pseudo landed in a different hard reg. Diffing that section at the FALSE-arm block header will show the exact allocation delta. Since ALL hoist-across-call axes regress, the lever must be either (a) purely inside the FALSE arm block (source order, decl order, block-local liveness) that has not yet been attempted, or (b) a construct that changes RA at the FALSE-arm entry without extending any value's live range past func_800486FC.
frontier.next_probe: Bootstrap tmp/gccdbg/cc1 with BB2_ALLOC_DEBUG=1 BB2_SCHED_DEBUG=1. Preprocess text1a.c to two forms (baseline + score-10 cheat form). Capture .greg for both. Diff `;; Register dispositions:` filtered to insns at 0x15cc-0x15e4. Identify moved pseudo(s). Enumerate C constructs that force that same allocation WITHIN the FALSE arm (no cross-call liveness): candidates include (i) reordering the three lbu source statements combined with a block-local pseudo-init pattern that makes b's SET LUID earlier than r/g's SETs (the frontier of the s2 block-local-split-fb axis, but with a live consumer that CSE cannot fold — perhaps an int-literal-mask ternary like `b = (*(u8*)(player+0x1A)) & 0xFF;` where the &0xFF creates a distinct RTL SET), (ii) computing `b` from a DIFFERENT base pointer that combine cannot collapse (e.g., a global-relative addressing form vs player-relative), (iii) an inline `s32 sp; sp = *(u8*)&player[0x1A/4]` word-load + shift pattern that changes the MEM's mode/size on the RTL and gives b a distinct dependency chain.

frontier.hypothesis: Chassis-2 (structurally different from chassis-1) permuter run — the s2/s3/s5 direct probes ruled out every simple structural variant (ternary-hoist, struct-cast, walking-pointer, block-local split, named-intermediate, block-local cp, function-scope cp, LIVE-b-hoist, color-byte hoist) as REGRESSIVE from baseline. Any chassis-2 must be a shape none of those cover: e.g., splitting the function into a called helper for the color-emit branch, or restructuring the two loops so their exit code merges with the color-emit block via a shared switch/dispatch.
frontier.mechanism: Permuter operates on random C-source mutations around a fixed chassis. If chassis-1 (current baseline) exhausts, chassis-2 must start from structurally different C — but the constraint is that chassis-2's baseline sandbox must not be much WORSE than chassis-1's baseline, else permuter searches a further-from-target neighborhood and can't find sub-2 legitimately.
frontier.next_probe: Design chassis-2 candidates whose direct sandbox stays within +/-5 of baseline while structurally differing from chassis-1. Ideas: (a) extract FALSE-arm color computation into a static-inline helper receiving `player` (may change RA around the call), (b) unify the two arms via a `s32 v; if (func_800486FC()) v = func_8004881C(...); else v = ...OR...;` shape with a single trailing `gnd_load_tex(...)` (already tested s2 ternary-hoist for a similar shape — score exploded to 32 due to two-block lbu structure being load-bearing; skip), (c) reshape loop2 exit (goto-vs-do-while) to change block layout preceding the color-emit region. Sandbox each, promote the best to chassis-2 permuter workspace.
